justification: Inspected `core/src/main/resources/examples/LoopUnroll.java`; it is a standalone example class whose only external dependencies are `java.util.Random` and `System.out`, while the rest of its calls are private helper methods within the same class. A repository-wide search (`rg -n "\bLoopUnroll\b" .`) found only this file and its own constructor/main references, so there is no evidence of high fan-in or high fan-out consistent with hub-like modularization.
